canonical_name: Turan finite simple-graph extremal theorem family (exact variant open)
literal_source_claim: The maximum number of edges in a graph containing no complete subgraph.
candidate_claim_not_credited_as_statemen: For positive r, every finite simple graph containing no clique of size r + 1 has at most as many edges as the balanced complete r-partite Turan graph, with equality only up to graph isomorphism.
statement_blocker: The catalog omits the forbidden clique order and does not select the sharp edge inequality, exact formula, equality case, uniqueness characterization, or extremal-number form. The exact 1941 proposition and its graph, parameter, arithmetic, and boundary conventions have not been independently reviewed.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_type: under Fintype V, G : SimpleGraph V, DecidableRel G.Adj, r : Nat, and 0 < r: G.IsTuranMaximal r iff Nonempty (G isomorphic as a graph to turanGraph (Fintype.card V) r)
